releases.name: Ten Turn Machine 2026-11-25
releases.body: Created Ten Turn Machine with a library of machine parts, turn cards, and a page where you place parts and run the machine. It then moved to an isometric board with drawn tile parts, a ball path, and cards you meet along the run.

jobs.description: Build a ball run machine from tile parts in ten turns, then watch it go.

releases.name: Turret Sight 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created Turret Sight, a low poly tank artillery game aimed from the turret seat. The creator seal now shows its flag image correctly.

jobs.description: Low poly tank artillery game aimed from the turret seat.

releases.name: Lob Hill 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created Lob Hill with hatch aiming, a map view, a computer opponent, and pass and play. It was rebuilt in the MobbyHill wireframe style with a turret seat view, wheel traverse, dials, pedals, and an orthographic map. New modes are Duel, Jeep raid, Bradley push, and Android swarm, along with a sandbag pit, driving, a new gun, and a drive panel.

jobs.description: Wireframe tank artillery from a dug in turret: duel a tank or hold the hill.

releases.name: Hopper 2026-11-25
releases.body: Created Hopper, then added slopes, stairs down, rolling boulders, and a climbing shaft with left wall jumps. Later versions added sky towers, gliders, parachutes, blast cannons, flight stretches, and a vertical camera.

releases.name: Hopper 2026-11-26
releases.body: Flight rings, updrafts, and islands are twice as high. The ground now sits at 70 percent of the height on tall screens, and the canvas uses a lighter resolution.

jobs.description: Endless side scrolling hopper with slopes, boulders, gliders, and flight stretches.

releases.name: Polygon Starfighter 2026-11-25
releases.body: Created Polygon Starfighter in the MobbyHill look with tilt controls. Later versions added a wireframe landing screen, five ships, lasers with barrel heat, enemy ships, Mothership Hunt, dogfight AI, a lead marker, turrets, three maps, Territory and Long haul modes, and homing mines. A Hover race mode brought terrain, a track, gates, and lap times. Also added were a cockpit view toggle and ore harvesting with outpost turrets in Territory.

releases.name: Polygon Starfighter 2026-11-26
releases.body: Added a Story mode campaign with briefings and ship unlocks. Online scores arrived with a leaderboard and a score server, and the game now connects to it. Story mode now follows the Starwake storyline.

jobs.description: Wireframe space dogfighting game with story missions, race and territory modes, and online scores.

releases.name: Bingo Server 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created the bingo server, which deals cards, tracks called numbers, and checks claims.

jobs.description: Server that runs shared bingo games with a rotating caller.

releases.name: Bingo 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created the bingo game page with joining, a card, calling the next number, claiming bingo, and starting a new game.

jobs.description: Play bingo with friends online, with a caller who rotates each game.

releases.name: Casino Server 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created the casino server with a shared shoe blackjack table, then added a Texas hold em table.

jobs.description: Server for shared video blackjack and Texas hold em tables.

releases.name: Pixel Casino 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created pixel video blackjack and pixel Texas hold em pages that play at shared tables.

jobs.description: Pixel video blackjack and Texas hold em at shared online tables.

releases.name: Ghost Wing 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created Ghost Wing v1 as a single page tile placing game.

jobs.description: Early Ghost Wing repo whose page is a tile placing map building game.

releases.name: Centipede Text Edition 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created Centipede Text Edition, then added a page description and favicon. Screen shake, flashes, shot trails, a slowdown when a wave clears, a combo multiplier, and Printout and Amber skins followed. Career mode with 10 levels and Puzzle mode with 12 solver verified puzzles were added last.

jobs.description: Centipede style arcade shooter drawn in letters, with career and puzzle modes.

releases.name: Rocketbench 2026-11-26
releases.body: Created Rocketbench, a time step rocket simulation with part stacking, staging, and missions.

jobs.description: Rocket flight simulator with part stacking, staging, and missions.
